message.content:
This document is a technical README for "Project Maya," a local LLM inference setup. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Supports three model families: GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, each offered in multiple "Maya" quant sizes (XS, S, S24, M, L) plus third-party quants (unsloth GGUF, EXL3, abliterated variants).
- Model sizes range from ~93 GB (MiniMax Maya-XS, fits a 128 GB PC
